operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range, including yourself.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application and preserves that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: Automatic ward application. Whenever a creature actually resolves a melee attack roll against the protected target while this ward is active, queue the stated retaliation once that attack finishes, hit or miss. A mere declaration canceled before any roll does not qualify.
operational.effect: The target gains +2 AC, subject to the strongest applicable flat-AC-bonus rule. A qualifying melee attacker takes 1 fire damage after its attack finishes, including normal damage/interception/concentration/death resolution. This queued retaliation is captured when the attack roll resolves against the active ward; a later ending caused by that attack does not erase the already queued packet. A reach attack remains melee. The limit is once per protected-target/attacking-creature/numbered-round across Flame Armor applications; replacement or another caster does not reset that round record.
operational.limitations: Only one Flame Armor can affect a target across all casters. A successful replacement ends the prior application and releases only its old concentration dependency. Retaliation is a new damage packet, not an attack or hit by the protected creature. Apply ordinary defenses, temporary HP, concentration checks and death consequences. This packet cannot start another Flame Armor, reflection/retaliation chain, resource gain, copied damage, derived healing, free Action/attack or generic on-hit rider unless an exact source explicitly names this retaliation. No Burn, illumination, heat aura or armor object is created. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of an older application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting a concentration spell still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, components, line of effect, RP and other costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and originating line of effect. No automatic upcast or level scaling unless this card explicitly prints companion-profile scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: +2 AC and 1 fire to melee attackers, Action/30 feet/V/S/F. CONFLICT RULING: concentration up to 1 minute and willing ward target replace mismatched Instantaneous/Spell-attack metadata. NEW: hit-or-miss roll trigger, after-attack packet, per-attacker/round limit and anti-chain rules. Exact-card completion captures an earned retaliation before attack-caused concentration loss and preserves the protected-target/attacker round cap across replacement.
